text: I had my wisdom tooth extracted at the age of 44 with Dr. Mint. The tooth was horizontal, located under the gum, very close to the nerve. I expected swelling for several days, but it subsided in just a few days, and I could chew normally on the side that was operated on after only 8 days. The extraction was quick, taking only 20 minutes. Dr. Mint and the team provided excellent and detailed advice. I highly recommend this clinic for those who don't want to wait in long queues. The clinic atmosphere was bright, spacious, and clean.
